changed.Text: Eat only if there are exactly two monsters in view. Polymorphs them into a blinking butterfly and a confusing eye.
changed.Translation: 仅在视野中恰有两只怪物时才能食用。将它们分别变成闪现蝴蝶和迷惑之眼。

changed.Text:
Polymorphs a random monster in view into a blinking butterfly, and a second monster, if any, into a confusing eye.
If no monsters are in view, gives @BVampirism@N for %d turns instead, preparing you for a vampiric ambush.
changed.Translation:
将视野中的一只随机怪物变成闪现蝴蝶；若还有第二只，则将其变成迷惑之眼。
若视野中没有怪物，则改为获得 @B吸血@N，持续 %d 回合，为吸血突袭做好准备。

changed.Text:
Creates 8 runes of same type: up to two at each diagonal on floor tiles, or randomly around the map if there’s no room.
The rune type is chosen randomly unless you are standing on a trap, in which case its rune type will be used.
changed.Translation:
生成 8 个同类符文：在地面上每个对角方向最多放置两个；若空间不足，则在地图上随机放置。
符文类型随机决定；若你正站在陷阱上，则使用该陷阱的符文类型。

changed.Text: Eat only if you are standing on a runic trap. Creates 8 runes of its type: up to two at each diagonal on floor tiles, or randomly around the map if there’s no room.
changed.Translation: 仅在你站在符文陷阱上时才能食用。生成 8 个同类符文：在地面上每个对角方向最多放置两个；若空间不足，则在地图上随机放置。

changed.Text: Makes you emit a beam that silently disintegrates any walls in front of you, until reaching a non-wall. Reveals terrain on the path.
changed.Translation: 发射一道光束，静默摧毁前方遇到的墙壁，直到遇到非墙地形为止，并显露沿途地形。

changed.Text: Eat only if you are next to 3 walls, and facing one of them. Makes you silently disintegrate all walls in front of you, until reaching a non-wall.
changed.Translation: 仅在你紧邻三面墙且面朝其中一面时才能食用。静默摧毁前方遇到的所有墙壁，直到遇到非墙地形为止。

changed.Text: Eat only if at least 4 monsters are hunting you, including any out of view ones.
changed.Translation: 仅在至少有四只怪物正在追猎你时才能食用，包括视野外的怪物。

changed.Text: Makes all monsters lose track of you and blinks away any that are next to you. Gives @BShadow@N for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 使所有怪物失去对你的追踪，并将身旁的怪物闪现带走。获得 @B暗影@N，持续 %d 回合。

changed.Text: Eat only if you are lignified, dazed, or poisoned.
changed.Translation: 仅在你处于木化、眩晕或中毒状态时才能食用。

changed.Text: %sRemoves all your statuses without the usual after-effects, then warps you away in view with greater chance to distant tiles.%s
changed.Translation: %s清除你的所有状态，且不会产生通常的后遗效果；随后将你传送到视野内的随机位置，远处格子的概率更高。%s

changed.Text: Eat only if you are next to at least 3 monsters.
changed.Translation: 仅在你至少紧邻三只怪物时才能食用。

changed.Text: Gives @BBerserk@N, @BLignification@N, and @BVampirism@N for 5 turns. Removes incompatible statuses. Renews duration and temporary HP bonuses if applicable.
changed.Translation: 获得 @B狂暴@N、@B木化@N和@B吸血@N，持续 5 回合，并移除不兼容的状态；如适用，还会刷新持续时间和临时生命值加成。

changed.Text: Eat only from the ground and not your inventory.
changed.Translation: 只能从地上拾取食用，不能从物品栏中食用。

changed.Text: Makes you sense nearby floor tiles and any entities on them (2× view range).
changed.Translation: 感知周围地面格及其上的所有实体（范围为视野的 2 倍）。

changed.Text: Eat if you are standing on a full totem, to empty the totem, and restore all your spirit charges.
changed.Translation: 站在已充能的图腾上时食用，可清空图腾并恢复所有灵体的充能。

changed.Text: Eat if you are standing on a full totem, to empty the totem, and restore two charges per spirit.
changed.Translation: 站在已充能的图腾上时食用，可清空图腾并为每个灵体恢复两点充能。

changed.Text: If you are standing on a full totem, empties it, and restores two charges per spirit.
changed.Translation: 若你站在已充能的图腾上，则清空图腾并为每个灵体恢复两点充能。

changed.Text: If you are standing on a full totem, empties it, and restores all your spirit charges.
changed.Translation: 若你站在已充能的图腾上，则清空图腾并恢复所有灵体的充能。

changed.Text:
If you are standing on a broken portal, makes it work again.
%s

changed.Translation:
若你站在故障传送门上，可使其恢复运作。
%s

changed.Text: Eat if you are standing on a broken portal, to make it work again.
changed.Translation: 站在故障传送门上时食用，可使其恢复运作。

changed.Text: You can’t get past its thorns!
It has to be planted in the ground!
It can only be eaten with exactly two monsters in view!
changed.Translation: 仅当视野中恰有两只怪物时才能食用！

changed.Text: Restores %+d HP. Leaves you either @Oconfused@N or @Oafraid@N for %d or %d turns respectively.
changed.Translation: 恢复 %+d 点生命值。随后你会陷入@O混乱@N或@O恐惧@N，分别持续 %d 或 %d 回合。
使你进入@B狂暴@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s
进入@B木化@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s

changed.Text: Makes you breathe a confusing fire beam in the current direction inflicting @OConfusion@N for %d turns and @OFire@N for %d turns. Burns foliage, producing fire clouds lasting 6-12 turns. Makes walls explode.%s
changed.Translation: 向当前方向喷出令人混乱的火焰。使目标陷入@O混乱@N %d 回合并@O着火@N %d 回合。点燃植被，形成持续 6–12 回合的火云，并炸毁墙壁。%s
木化期间你能抵抗传送。
木化时则恢复 %+d 点生命值。

changed.Text: Teleports you away and makes you sense any totemic spirit. Leaves you either @Odazed@N or @Oimbalanced@N for %d or %d turns respectively.%s
changed.Translation: 将你传送离开，并使你感知所有图腾灵体。随后你会陷入@O眩晕@N或@O失衡@N，分别持续 %d 或 %d 回合。%s
无论如何，都会恢复 %+d 点生命值。

changed.Text:
If you are standing on foliage, gives @BDisorient@N for %d turns and increases visibility around, changing plain walls into translucent ones and foliage into floor.
Otherwise, gives @BGardener@N for %d turns and changes instead translucent walls into plain ones.%s
changed.Translation:
若你站在植被上，则获得@B迷向@N状态，持续 %d 回合，并提高周围能见度，将普通墙壁变为半透明墙、将植被变为地面。
否则，获得@B园艺师@N状态，持续 %d 回合，并将半透明墙变回普通墙。%s

changed.Text: Invoking “focus” while dazed would be useless.
changed.Translation: 眩晕时使用“专注”毫无作用。

changed.Text: Invoking “dig” while dazed would be useless.
changed.Translation: 眩晕时使用“掘地”毫无作用。

changed.Text: You cannot jump while poisoned and almost dead.
changed.Translation: 中毒且濒死时无法跳跃。

changed.Text: There’s no room to jump in that direction.
changed.Translation: 那个方向没有足够空间跳跃。

changed.Text: Jump in the current direction to the furthest free position in view. You will attack any monsters on the path with +1 attack and @Odaze@N them for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 沿当前方向跳至视野内最远的空位。途中会攻击所有怪物，攻击力 +1，并使其@O眩晕@N %d 回合。

changed.Text: A strong gale pushes the air away from you.
changed.Translation: 强风将周围的空气推开。

changed.Text: Hurt foes in the four cardinal directions for 1 damage when ranged and 1-2 in melee. Pushes foes away and @Ounbalances@N them for %d turns. Dissipates clouds except foliage fires that propagate instead.
changed.Translation: 伤害四个正交方向上的敌人：远程造成 1 点伤害，近战造成 1–2 点。将敌人推开并使其@O失衡@N %d 回合。驱散云雾，但植被火焰会因此蔓延。

changed.Text: You cannot invoke “stop time” when you’re already freezing time.
changed.Translation: 你已处于止时状态，无法再次使用“止时”。
进入@B止时@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s @G即时生效@N。

changed.Text: You spin around chasing your tail.
changed.Translation: 你转着圈追自己的尾巴。

changed.Text: Perform a tail-slap attack with +1 effective damage on any adjacent foes while turning around, @Ounbalancing@N them for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 转身甩尾攻击相邻敌人，造成的有效伤害 +1，并使其@O失衡@N %d 回合。

changed.Text: Invoking “vampirism” while dazed would be useless.
changed.Translation: 眩晕时使用“吸血”毫无作用。

changed.Text: You cannot invoke “vampirism” when you’re already vampiric.
changed.Translation: 你已处于吸血状态，无法再次使用“吸血”。

你伤势过重，无法使用“闪电”。

changed.Text: You emit a static discharge (-%d HP).
changed.Translation: 你释放静电（-%d 点生命值）。

changed.Text: Inflict 1-3 damage on any chain of monsters adjacent to you. Damage decreases with distance. Affected monsters are @Odazed@N for %d turns. Hurts you too for 1 HP.
changed.Translation: 对所有相邻的一串怪物造成 1–3 点伤害，伤害随距离递减。受影响的怪物会@O眩晕@N %d 回合。你也会受到 1 点伤害。

changed.Text: Frighten all monsters within %d tiles of distance for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 恐吓距离你 %d 格内的所有怪物，持续 %d 回合。

changed.Text: You emit a confusing noxious smell.
changed.Translation: 你散发出令人混乱的恶臭。

changed.Text: Confuse monsters within %d tiles of distance for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 使距离你 %d 格内的怪物陷入混乱，持续 %d 回合。
生长的根须使敌人木化。
视野内没有可木化的敌人。

changed.Text: Lignify monsters in view for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 使视野内的怪物木化 %d 回合。

changed.Text: There’s no room to spit poison.
changed.Translation: 没有足够空间喷吐毒雾。

changed.Text: Spit poisonous clouds on the sides and in front of you up to two free tiles away, lasting 7-11 turns.
changed.Translation: 向前方及两侧最多两格外的空位喷出毒云，持续 7–11 回合。

changed.Text: Invoking “sprint” while dazed would be useless.
changed.Translation: 眩晕时使用“冲刺”毫无作用。

changed.Text: You cannot invoke “sprint” while you’re already sprinting.
changed.Translation: 你已处于冲刺状态，无法再次使用“冲刺”。
进入@B冲刺@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s @G即时生效@N。

changed.Text: You cannot retreat while poisoned and almost dead.
changed.Translation: 中毒且濒死时无法撤退。

changed.Text: Walk backwards up to two tiles while leaving a fire cloud lasting 6-12 turns.
changed.Translation: 向后移动最多两格，并留下持续 6–12 回合的火云。
@B暗影@N状态还会持续 %d 回合。%s @G即时生效@N。

changed.Text: You cannot get a snack while lignified.
No comestibles remaining in the map.
You teleport for a quick snack!

changed.Translation: 你已处于园艺师状态，无法再次使用“园艺”。
进入@B园艺师@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s @G即时生效@N。

changed.Translation: 摧毁半径两格内的墙壁，并使你进入@B狂暴@N状态 %d 回合。

changed.Text: You cannot invoke “death stare” while afraid.
changed.Translation: 恐惧时无法使用“死亡凝视”。

changed.Text: You give a deadly stare at the %s.
You cannot use “death stare” without a visible foe in front.
changed.Translation: 前方没有可见敌人，无法使用“死亡凝视”。

changed.Text: Kill first visible foe in front. Gives you @OFear@N for %d turns as backlash.
changed.Translation: 杀死前方第一个可见敌人。作为反噬，你会陷入@O恐惧@N %d 回合。

changed.Text: You cannot lay a rune on a non-floor tile.
changed.Translation: 无法在非地面格上布置符文。

changed.Text: You cannot lay a rune on a non-free tile.
changed.Translation: 无法在被占据的格子上布置符文。

changed.Text: Lay a random runic trap on current floor tile.
changed.Translation: 在当前地面格上布置随机符文陷阱。
进入@B迷向@N状态，持续 %d 回合。%s @G即时生效@N。

changed.Text: Emits a noisy echoing sound that disintegrates nearby walls and reveals the frontier formed by map walls adjacent to interior ones.
changed.Translation: 发出响亮的回声，震碎附近的墙壁，并揭示与内部墙壁相邻的地图边界。

changed.Translation: 将距离你 %d 格内的怪物传送走，并揭示所有传送门的位置。地城可能会察觉到你并派遣幽灵调查；你所在层数越深，发生概率越高。

changed.Text: Makes many poisonous clouds appear within %d tiles of distance. Reveals translucent walls.
changed.Translation: 在距离你 %d 格内生成大量毒云，并揭示半透明墙壁。

changed.Text:
The wandering or guarding behavior of monsters is hidden with Corrupted Dungeon. While most of the time the roles remain the same as in the base game, you’ll occasionally have to guess based on actual behavior.

Various thematic levels of diverse rarity may appear. They can be quite surprising!

Sometimes, map corruption events happen. In particular, lots of long-lasting fog may spawn at once in the whole level. Beware however that this event is accompanied by a reduction in foliage and rubble around the map, so the temporarily reduced visibility progressively switches to an increased visibility.
changed.Translation:
启用“腐化地城”后，怪物的游荡或守卫行为会被隐藏。大多数时候，它们的职责与基础游戏相同，但你偶尔需要根据实际行动猜测其行为。

游戏中可能出现多种主题楼层，出现概率各不相同，内容也可能相当出人意料！

有时会发生地图腐化事件。尤其要注意，整层可能同时生成大量持续较久的雾气。不过，事件也会减少地图上的植物和瓦砾，因此视野会先暂时缩小，随后逐步扩大。

changed.Text:
Some advanced secondary spirit traits are a bit tricky to use or understand.

Zebra’s “dazzling” trait means that any attack directed at you will be redirected to any monster just on your other side. It hence encourages weird positioning tactics. Also, with Zebra, monsters notice you instantly, without losing a turn, so beware of sudden ranged attacks during exploration.

The Lion’s roaring happens on first sight, but detecting a monster first beyond view with @BClarity@N will prevent the roaring. Fear duration is 4-5, with 4 being more likely a short distances, because monsters get over their Fear more quickly when the danger is close.

The Gawalt weakens by 1 damage any hits doing more than 2 base damage and two thirds of the hits doing 2 base damage. Accuracy is preserved.

The Bear ignores any special requirements for eating rare comestibles.

When the Elephant is in a dead-end or the Gawalt is on a menhir tile, wandering monsters don’t notice you, but hunting monsters still see you.

The Chicken not triggering traps is as simple as it sounds, but given how wandering monsters avoid traps, it has subtle stealth implications.

@MNote.@N Unless combined with Totem Conditions, this mod makes regular spirits rarer early on than advanced ones, to make it harder to skip those.
changed.Translation:
部分高级副灵体特性较难理解或运用。

斑马的“炫目”特性会把指向你的攻击转移给你另一侧紧邻的怪物，因此需要采用特别的站位策略。此外，斑马会让怪物立刻发现你，不会让怪物损失一个回合；探索时要小心突然遭到远程攻击。

狮子会在初次看见怪物时咆哮，但若你先在视野外通过@B清明@N感知到怪物，就能避免咆哮。恐惧持续 4 至 5 回合，距离较近时更可能持续 4 回合，因为危险越近，怪物越快克服恐惧。

獾会使基础伤害超过 2 的攻击伤害降低 1 点，也会使造成 2 点基础伤害的攻击中约三分之二降低 1 点伤害，但不会影响命中率。

熊会忽略食用稀有食物的特殊要求。

大象处于死路，或獾站在石碑格上时，游荡怪物不会注意到你，但追猎中的怪物仍能看见你。

鸡不会触发陷阱，规则看似简单；但由于游荡怪物会避开陷阱，这也会带来一些微妙的潜行影响。

@M注意：@N若未与“图腾条件”同时启用，此模组会让普通灵体在游戏前期比高级灵体更稀有，使你更难跳过高级灵体。

changed.Text: Provides various tips for new players.
changed.Translation: 为新玩家提供一些实用提示。

changed.Text:
@YGENERAL TIPS@N

Shamogu is a @Mturn-based@N game: take your time when in perilous situations!

Always check your inventory to see if some spirit ability or comestible can help in your situation. The sooner is often the better!

Wasting spirit charges and comestibles is bad, but dying without using them is worse!

Most items and abilities have several effects and can be used for several purposes. For example, barking or freezing time may be useful both when attacking and fleeing, but freezing time can also help wait for some problematic status effect to end.

@YCOMBAT TIPS@N

Try to always get the @Mfirst hit@N against monsters. In particular, avoid moving yourself in front of ranged or rampaging monsters. Zigzag if necessary. Don’t forget that even plain melee monsters can charge frontally from one tile away!

Try to learn the characteristics of each kind of monster. You can examine monsters to see their attack, defense and special traits.

Remember that monsters with N attack can only hit for the minimum of N and 3 damage at most, except for burning phoenixes and ranged fire llamas that may burn you, and four-headed hydras that perform four damage-rolls per attack.

Some ranged monsters, like fire llamas or lashing frogs, are more dangerous ranged than in melee. You may sometimes want to force melee even if you’re ranged too!

Various monsters have special attacks. For example, acid mounds ignore defense, and venomous vipers may poison you.

@YSTEALTH TIPS@N

Killing all the monsters does not provide any benefit. So, once you have enough food items and don’t need more totems or already found one, you can skip exploring the rest of the map and go through a portal to the next level. Also, missing a totem or two is acceptable.

Monsters usually give up quickly their search once they don’t see you: use foliage and rubble to lose them. Beware of rats that hunt you by smell, though.

Watch out for @Mfootstep noise@N: while going through dense foliage, it can be very helpful to avoid unwanted encounters.

@YCONFIGURATION TIPS@N

If you often get surprised by @OFire@N or @OPoison@N and get hurt by mistake, you may want to enable extra warnings in the configuration options. Those warnings also stop you when @BBerserk@N or @BLignification@N is about to expire.

@YWIZARD MODE@N

While the recommended way to discover the game is to progressively improve your skills by analyzing and enjoying your previous deaths, frustrated casual players should consider enabling @MWizard Mode@N(W) before giving up. Without further enabling extra cheats, it works as a kind of “adventure mode” that simply resurrects you each time you die. Resurrections are recorded in the game’s timeline, so you can check later how many lives you spent and try to do better next time until you can win in the default permadeath mode.

@YCHALLENGE TIPS@N

If, on the contrary, you find Shamogu too easy, you’re encouraged to try the various expansion and challenge mods accessible after pressing TAB or SPACE in the new game menu!
changed.Translation:
@Y一般提示@N

Shamogu 是一款@M回合制@N游戏：遇到危险时不必慌张，可以从容思考！

经常检查物品栏，看看灵体能力或食物能否帮你应对当前局面。通常越早使用越好！

浪费灵体充能和食物固然可惜，但带着它们死去更糟！

多数物品和能力都有多种效果与用途。例如，吠叫或冻结时间既可用于攻击，也可用于逃跑；冻结时间还可以拖到棘手状态结束。

@Y战斗提示@N

尽量先于怪物出手，争取@M先攻@N。尤其要避免走到远程或狂暴怪物的正前方，必要时可以曲折移动。别忘了，即使普通近战怪物也能从一格外正面冲锋！

熟悉各类怪物的特点。检查怪物可以查看其攻击、防御和特殊特性。

攻击值为 N 的怪物，单次最多造成 N 与 3 中较小的伤害；燃烧凤凰和远程喷火羊驼可能使你着火，四头九头蛇每次攻击则会进行四次伤害判定。

有些远程怪物，例如喷火羊驼或抽打青蛙，远程攻击比近战更危险。即使你也有远程攻击，有时仍应设法贴近它们！

许多怪物拥有特殊攻击。例如酸液丘会无视防御，毒蛇可能使你中毒。

@Y潜行提示@N

杀光所有怪物并无额外好处。食物充足、不再需要图腾，或已经找到图腾后，可以不探索地图剩余部分，直接通过传送门前往下一层。漏掉一两个图腾也没关系。

怪物看不见你后通常很快就会放弃搜索；利用植物和瓦砾摆脱追踪。不过要小心会凭气味追猎你的老鼠。

留意@M脚步声@N：穿过茂密植物时，控制脚步声有助于避免不必要的遭遇。

@Y配置提示@N

如果你常被@O火焰@N或@O毒素@N打个措手不及，可以在配置中启用额外警告。状态@B狂暴@N或@B木化@N即将结束时，这些警告也会提醒你。

@Y向导模式@N

建议通过复盘并享受每次失败，逐步提升技巧来认识游戏。如果你因此感到沮丧，可以在放弃前尝试启用@M向导模式@N（W）。无需开启其他作弊功能，它就像一种“冒险模式”，每次死亡都会让你复活。复活记录在游戏时间线中，你可以查看消耗了几条命，并继续尝试，直到能在默认的永久死亡模式中获胜。

@Y挑战提示@N

如果你觉得 Shamogu 太简单，可以在新游戏菜单按 TAB 或空格键，试试各种扩展和挑战模组！

使用 xterm 256 色调色板（近似 Solarized 配色）

changed.Text: use true color selenized palette (not supported by all terminals)
changed.Translation: 使用真彩色 Selenized 调色板（并非所有终端都支持）
你感觉好多了（+%d 点生命值）。
你感到虚弱（-%d 点生命值）。
你感觉没有变化（+0 点生命值）。
可远程抓取敌人并使其@O失衡@N
拖拽并使敌人@O失衡@N的攻击
带后退效果的远程攻击
无声扭曲空间的远程攻击

changed.Text: ranged space-distorting silent attack that may @Odaze@N foes
changed.Translation: 无声扭曲空间并可能使敌人@O眩晕@N的远程攻击
转身缓慢（无法边转身边攻击）
每多一个敌人，攻击力便提高

changed.Text: spines may @Odaze@N attacking foes in melee
changed.Translation: 近战攻击者可能被尖刺@O眩晕@N

changed.Text: dazzling (redirect attacks just behind you, easily noticed)
changed.Translation: 炫目（将攻击转向你身后的敌人，但容易被发现）

changed.Text: rat phobia, difficult rotation when facing a wall, unnoticed in dead-ends, immune to berserk after-effects
changed.Translation: 害怕老鼠；面墙时转向困难；在死路中不会被察觉；免疫狂暴后遗症

changed.Text: wall-jumping movement and attack, weakened hits, menhir sensing and hiding
changed.Translation: 蹬墙跳移动与攻击；命中伤害降低；可感知并藏匿于石碑处

changed.Text: gluttony (needs to eat in pairs, but ignores other requirements)
changed.Translation: 贪食（必须成对进食，但忽略其他进食条件）

changed.Text: nocturnal (reduced view range), flies over foliage
changed.Translation: 夜行（视野范围较小），可飞越植被
冲锋会推开敌人并使其@O失衡@N

changed.Text: senses and doesn’t trigger runes, cackles loudly on sighting a portal or totem, confusion vulnerability (longer duration)
changed.Translation: 能感知符文但不会触发；看见传送门或图腾时会大声咯咯笑；容易陷入混乱（持续时间更长）
初次发现时会发出恐怖咆哮
木质腿（木化时仍可移动）
发现你时会吠叫并使你@O恐惧@N
失衡易伤（被点燃的概率降低）
命中时可能推开敌人并使其@O失衡@N

changed.Text: hunts you by smell, becomes berserk if you eat in view
changed.Translation: 能循着气味追猎你；若在其视野内进食，它会陷入狂暴

changed.Text: plays guitar for you, afraid of you
changed.Translation: 会为你弹吉他，但害怕你
发现你时会释放使目标@B木化@N的孢子

changed.Text: hits may @Blignify@N you, hits ignore lignification’s defense bonus, woody legs, permanently lignified
changed.Translation: 命中可能使你@B木化@N；攻击无视木化的防御加成；木质腿；永久木化
命中时可能使你短暂@B狂暴@N
容易受@O火焰@N影响（持续时间更长）
抵抗@O混乱@N（持续时间减半）
抵抗@O眩晕@N（眩晕时仍可召唤灵体）
抵抗@O恐惧@N（持续时间减半）
抵抗@O失衡@N（持续时间减半）
抵抗@O中毒@N（持续时间减半）

changed.Text: Gives %+d Attack and +1 effective damage. Provides temporary HP bonus. Protects from @OFear@N. Followed by @OPoison@N on expiration for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 攻击力 %+d，造成的有效伤害 +1，并获得临时生命值加成。抵抗@O恐惧@N。效果结束后会@O中毒@N %d 回合。

changed.Text: Protects from @OConfusion@N, @ODaze@N, and @BBerserk@N. Makes you sense nearby monsters (2× view range).
changed.Translation: 抵抗@O混乱@N、@O眩晕@N和@B狂暴@N。使你能够感知附近的怪物（范围为视野的 2 倍）。

changed.Text: Using spirit abilities will hurt you for 1 damage. Doubles duration of new @OImbalance@N, @ODaze@N and @OFear@N effects.
changed.Translation: 使用灵体能力会使你受到 1 点伤害。新获得的@O失衡@N、@O眩晕@N和@O恐惧@N效果持续时间加倍。

changed.Text: Forbids all actions except waiting or eating until you’re hurt or it expires.
changed.Translation: 在受到伤害或效果结束前，除等待或进食外无法行动。

changed.Text: Allows walking into walls. Gives +1 effective damage when charging and guarantees pushing hits (even in melee).
changed.Translation: 允许撞入墙中。冲锋时有效伤害 +1，并保证攻击会推开敌人（近战也有效）。

changed.Text: Makes any hunting monsters in view move in the opposite direction with respect to your current direction. Monsters may mistakenly attack any monster on the way while doing so. Disoriented monsters do not perform four-directional charges.
changed.Translation: 使视野内所有追猎中的怪物朝与你当前方向相反的方向移动。它们途中可能误伤其他怪物。迷向的怪物不会进行四向冲锋。

changed.Text: Forbids attacking and walking toward foes.
changed.Translation: 无法攻击敌人或朝敌人移动。

changed.Text: Remaining in place or moving into a cloud of fire will burn you for %d damage. When first catching @OFire@N, you also get burned once immediately.
changed.Translation: 停留原地或走入火云会使你受到 %d 点伤害。首次@O着火@N时还会立即额外受到一次伤害。

changed.Text: Attack frontally with all four heads.
changed.Translation: 用四个头从正面发起攻击。

changed.Text: Exudes fog on the sides and behind. Protects from @OFire@N and @BLignification@N.
changed.Translation: 向两侧和身后释放雾气。抵抗@O火焰@N和@B木化@N。

changed.Text: Grows foliage in a 2-tile radius each turn.
changed.Translation: 每回合在半径 2 格内生长植被。

changed.Text: Unless you eat before expiration, you’ll eat a random comestible without taking a turn. If there is no food, you’ll become confused for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 若效果结束前没有进食，你会不消耗回合地吃下一份随机食物。若没有食物，则会陷入混乱 %d 回合。

changed.Text: Halves attack. When also confused, gives %+d Defense.
changed.Translation: 攻击力减半。若同时处于混乱状态，则防御力 %+d。

changed.Text: Gives %+d Defense. Caps incoming attack damage at 1. Provides temporary HP bonus. Protects from @OPoison@N and @OImbalance@N. Delays burning. Prevents movement. Followed by @OImbalance@N for you and any adjacent actors on expiration for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 防御力 %+d，受到的攻击伤害最多为 1，并获得临时生命值加成。抵抗@O中毒@N和@O失衡@N，延缓燃烧，但无法移动。效果结束时，你和相邻生物会@O失衡@N %d 回合。

changed.Text: Walking will hurt you for %d damage. Stinky toxins are exuded on expiration, confusing other creatures for %d turns.
changed.Translation: 移动会使你受到 %d 点伤害。效果结束时会散发臭味毒素，使其他生物混乱 %d 回合。

changed.Text: Harmonic shadows make non-hunting monsters not notice you unless you attack them. You can move instantly through translucent walls. It makes combat silent and hits make hunting monsters lose track of you.
changed.Translation: 和谐暗影会让非追猎状态的怪物无法察觉你，除非你攻击它们。你可以瞬间穿过半透明墙。战斗不会发出声音，命中敌人还会让追猎中的怪物跟丢你。

changed.Text: You can move to a visible destination three times as fast on the current direction and twice as fast laterally. You can jump over foes, unbalancing them. Canceled by waiting.
changed.Translation: 你可以沿当前方向以三倍速度移动到可见地点，横向则为两倍速度。还可跳过敌人并使其失衡。等待会结束此状态。

changed.Text: Time is frozen for everyone but you until expiration. Status effects affecting you will still progress.
changed.Translation: 效果结束前，除你之外所有生物的时间都会冻结；影响你的状态仍会继续计时。

changed.Text: Guarantees successful attack that restores HP for the amount of damage you deal. Gives %+d Attack.
changed.Translation: 攻击必定命中，并按造成的伤害恢复生命值。攻击力 %+d。

changed.Text: HP never falls below 1 after losing bonus HP. Duration and HP bonus may be renewed by eating a berserking flower.
changed.Translation: 失去额外生命值后，生命值不会低于 1。食用狂暴花可刷新持续时间和额外生命值。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable by eating clarity leaves. May be removed by eating a berserking flower for half the @BBerserk@N duration.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过食用明晰叶获得。食用狂暴花可移除此效果，并获得一半持续时间的@B狂暴@N。

changed.Text: Players with “daze resistance” can still invoke spirits; status shows as @O%s*@N for them.
changed.Translation: 拥有眩晕抗性的玩家仍可召唤灵体；对他们而言，该状态显示为 @O%s*@N。

changed.Text: Confused monsters will attack other monsters too when adjacent. Some monsters may even hurt or affect themselves when performing special actions like digging, spitting fire, barking, or pushing.
changed.Translation: 混乱的怪物在与其他怪物相邻时也会攻击它们。有些怪物使用挖掘、喷火、吠叫或推撞等特殊行动时，甚至会伤到自己或受到影响。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable with the Dazzling Zebra spirit or by eating a moonlight lotus.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过炫目斑马灵体或食用月光莲获得。

changed.Text: Monsters will flee when facing you. Ambushing charges against unseen foes can still happen. At the end of a turn, a cornered and afraid actor with no possible escape will become berserk. When lignified and afraid, getting hit makes you berserk, too.
changed.Translation: 怪物面对你时会逃跑，但仍可能从视野外发动伏击冲锋。回合结束时，若被困且恐惧的生物无路可逃，就会陷入狂暴。木化且恐惧时受到攻击也会使你狂暴。

changed.Text: Players with “fire resistance” from the upgraded Fire Salamander don’t take that extra immediate damage.
changed.Translation: 升级火蜥蜴后获得火焰抗性，不会受到额外的即时伤害。

changed.Text: Cancels @BSprint@N. Player-only effect obtainable with the Four-Headed Hydra spirit.
changed.Translation: 会结束@B冲刺@N。仅玩家可获得，可通过四头九头蛇灵体获得。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable by eating a foggy-skin onion. May be removed by eating a lignification fruit for half the @BLignification@N duration.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过食用雾肤洋葱获得。食用木化果可移除此效果，并获得一半持续时间的@B木化@N。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable with the Gardening Lion spirit or by eating a moonlight lotus.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过园艺狮灵体或食用月光莲获得。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable with the Gluttonous Bear spirit.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过贪食熊灵体获得。

changed.Text: Sprinting or jumping while imbalanced may sometimes lead to a @Odazing@N fall.
changed.Translation: 失衡时冲刺或跳跃有时会使你@O眩晕@N倒地。

changed.Text: The player’s HP never falls below 3 after losing bonus HP. Monsters’ HP floor is only 1, like for @BBerserk@N. Duration and HP bonus may be renewed by eating a lignification fruit. Cancels @BSprint@N. Actors with “woody legs” aren’t rooted, so they lack delayed burning protection but can move while lignified at the cost of reducing the duration by an extra turn; status shows as @B%s*@N for them, and there is no @OImbalance@N on expiration, because no root withdrawing happens.
changed.Translation: 失去额外生命值后，玩家生命值不会低于 3；怪物则与@B狂暴@N一样，最低为 1。食用木化果可刷新持续时间和额外生命值。此状态会结束@B冲刺@N。“木质腿”生物不会扎根，因此没有延迟燃烧保护，但木化时仍可移动，代价是额外减少一回合持续时间；其状态标记为@B%s*@N，结束时也不会@O失衡@N，因为没有根须收回。

changed.Text: Watch out for confusion if any monsters survive poisoning!
changed.Translation: 若有怪物在中毒后存活，请小心它们可能陷入混乱！

changed.Text: Note that hitting a wandering monster will make it hunt you as usual. Player-only effect obtainable with the Gawalt Monkey spirit or by eating a vanishing snail.
changed.Translation: 注意，攻击游荡中的怪物会使其照常开始追猎你。仅玩家可获得，可通过加瓦尔特猴灵体或食用隐匿蜗牛获得。

changed.Text: Disables normal attack. Player-only effect obtainable with the Sprinting Gazelle spirit.
changed.Translation: 无法进行普通攻击。仅玩家可获得，可通过疾驰瞪羚灵体获得。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable with the Temporal Cat spirit.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过时序猫灵体获得。

changed.Text: Player-only effect obtainable with the Vampiric Bat spirit or by eating a polymorph fungus.
changed.Translation: 仅玩家可获得，可通过吸血蝙蝠灵体或食用变形菌获得。

changed.Text: You expulse stinky and confusing toxins.
changed.Translation: 你排出带有恶臭、令人混乱的毒素。

changed.Text: The %s expulses stinky and confusing toxins.
changed.Translation: %s排出了带有恶臭、令人混乱的毒素。

changed.Text: You cannot hold your appetite any longer!
changed.Translation: 你再也无法忍受饥饿了！

changed.Text: You search but cannot find anything to eat!
changed.Translation: 你四处寻找，却找不到任何食物！

changed.Text: A strange energy disturbs your teleportation!
changed.Translation: 一股奇异能量干扰了你的传送！
